context.exploration_scope: Executed the final real path from S25's TRIGGER_READY: compared each Principle's own real state against S25's gated checkpoint (not its readiness probe), and for any Principle whose state actually changed, ran Independent->Principle->Compare->Outcome with the independent verdict winning on any disagreement

problem: S25 proved the Independent->Principle->Compare pipeline was mechanically operable via a read-only probe, but a probe is explicitly not an applied outcome -- the final real path still had to be exercised through its actual gate (checkpoint vs live state) with a genuine, recorded, advisory-only Outcome, and had to keep the S25 probe cleanly separate from the S25 gated checkpoint so this phase does not accidentally treat a dry-run value as if it were the last real recorded state.

decision.decision_summary: P1 real_state_changed=false (left untouched). P2 real_state_changed=false (left untouched). synthetic_change_injected=false. no_real_file_written=true. 0 automatic real project modification, 0 CI wiring, 0 automatic policy, 0 automatic execution. Overall verdict: NO_REAL_TRIGGER.

action.action_summary: Compared each Principle's own last recorded gated checkpoint (from S25, explicitly not the S25 readiness probe) against a fresh read of the real trace/hold/overlay files; executed Independent->Principle->Compare->Outcome only for a Principle whose real state changed; on any disagreement, used the independent verdict as the Outcome's recommended_disposition; never wrote any Outcome back to a real file and never forced an existing status to change.

evidence.evidence_detail: final_state=NO_REAL_TRIGGER, p1_real_state_changed=false, p2_real_state_changed=false, synthetic_change_injected=false, no_real_file_written=true, regression_all_passed=true, dangling=0, duplicates=0

result.note: Correctly reported NO_REAL_TRIGGER against the S25 gated checkpoint, with no synthetic change substituted -- neither Principle executed its judgment loop, which is the correct final-path behavior when real data has not moved.

cause.root_cause_summary: The final real path differs from every prior trigger check in one respect: it is the point where a recommended Outcome is actually produced for a real change, so it is also the point where accidentally treating S25's non-applied readiness probe as if it were a real checkpoint would be most consequential -- keeping the probe and the gated checkpoint as two structurally distinct fields in S25's own output (and reading only the gated one here) is what prevents that conflation.

lesson: A final real-trigger-execution phase has to draw its checkpoint from the OTHER phase's actual applied trigger state, never from a readiness probe or dry-run value computed alongside it, even when both were computed from the same real data and would happen to agree -- the two serve different claims (one asserts nothing, one is a genuine checkpoint), and only one of them is safe to advance the loop's baseline from.
